SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3

Pinned, locally served browser parser for CSV/Excel master imports.
The simulator reads .xlsx workbooks with this library; it does not load an
external CDN when a user imports a workbook. Excel formulas are not evaluated
and are rejected in data sheets by tabular-import.js.

Official standalone source:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
Official license source:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE
Integration documentation:
https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/

License: Apache-2.0. See SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt in this directory.
